text: {"lessons":["My account has generally held steady and recently grown without frequent trading, so I should not trade just to react to ordinary monthly fluctuations.","Selling some Stock A after a large gain and selling D and E at losses did not by itself show those were good decisions; I should base trades on the portfolio’s risks and outlook, not gains or losses versus cost.","As a retired investor relying on savings and pension, I should favor diversification, preserve cash for expenses, and avoid taking risks that could cause large losses."]}
